map.累进税下的平均税率: Average tax rate under a progressive tax
map.若 3 万元税来自 10 万元所得，ATR=30%；若所得翻倍到 20 万而税只: If 30k tax comes from 100k income, ATR=30%; if income doubles to 200k and tax only rises to 50k, ATR drops to 25%, showing progressivity.
map.平均税率与边际税率有何不同？: How does average tax rate differ from marginal tax rate?
map.平均税率是总税÷总所得，反映整体负担；边际税率是最后一单位所得适用的税率，决定增: Average rate is total tax over total income, reflecting the overall burden; marginal rate is the rate on the last unit of income, driving incremental incentives.
map.为什么平均税率总是低于边际税率？: Why is the average tax rate always below the marginal rate?
map.在累进税制下，低收入部分适用低档税率，只有超出部分适用高档，所以平均税率小于边际: Under a progressive system, lower income faces lower brackets and only the excess faces higher ones, so the average stays below the marginal rate.
